name: wingmate
description: WingMate: meet the guests on your flight. Front end in TypeScript, themed for AirAsia.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test: node build.mjs && node tests/api.test.mjs && TARGET=worker node tests/api.test.mjs
